rows.title: Merchant config is data
rows.defect: config validation problems are collected but never raised
rows.test: a bad config entry is refused at load

rows.title: Netflix: a headings page
rows.defect: the section only stops at a strictly higher heading, so it runs into the next section
rows.test: the section stops at the next same-level heading

rows.title: Spotify: a numbered-clauses page
rows.defect: the clause only stops at a shallower clause, so 5.3 is swallowed
rows.test: the clause stops at the next clause of the same depth

rows.title: { text, hash, fetched_at }
rows.defect: the hash is taken over the raw page, not the extracted terms
rows.test: the hash is SHA-256 of the extracted text

rows.title: Unreadable is said, never filled in
rows.defect: the HTTP status is ignored and the error page is parsed as terms

rows.title: Facts only from literal phrases
rows.defect: a fact rule fires whether or not its phrase is in the text
rows.test: removing the phrase removes the fact

rows.title: The card snapshots the terms
rows.defect: the case does not keep the terms snapshot
rows.test: the case keeps text, hash and fetched_at

rows.title: Execution re-reads
rows.defect: the comparison is inverted, so unchanged terms stop the run

rows.title: A terms change stops the run
rows.test: a changed sentence stops the run and re-cards

rows.title: A failed re-read stops the run
No readable terms, no card
rows.defect: an unreadable terms page still lets the card go up
rows.test: a 403 before the card means no card

rows.title: The second merchant end to end
rows.defect: merchants are looked up by the full descriptor only
rows.test: a descriptor like SPOTIFY USA finds the spotify entry

rows.title: The snapshot is a copy
rows.defect: the case holds the reader's object by reference
rows.test: a mutated cache cannot rewrite the card's terms

rows.title: Quote the published terms with source and time
rows.defect: the quote drops its source and time
rows.test: the reply names the terms URL and the read time

rows.title: Cosmetic changes keep the hash
rows.test: curly quotes and markup keep the hash
